prompt: Round 3 of 4. The researcher side proposes (We want university ownership of results with a non-exclusive licence to the company, as this is our standard positio

content.text:
The researcher wants uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence instead of contract_research_company_owns. This is a significant concession - we lose ownership of results. I should counter-propose: accept the 30-day review (that's better for us anyway) but push back on IP. I'll propose uni_owns_option_to_assign as a middle ground - university owns but we have option to take over. That's better than non-exclusive licence for our competitive position. I can trade by accepting the 30-day review period.

Two fields I can change: ip (from uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence to uni_owns_option_to_assign) - that's one change. The sheet already has 30 days review. So I'm accepting the 30 days and changing ip. That's one change from their proposal.
